2. 1. 2. 1. 

(Sāvatthinidānaṃ)

Dvemāni bhikkhave balāni. Katamāni dve: paṭisaṅkhānabalañca, bhāvanābalañca. Katamañca bhikkhave paṭisaṅkhānabalaṃ. Idha bhikkhave ekacco iti paṭisañcikkhati: kāyaduccaritassa kho pāpako vipāko diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañca, vacīduccaritassa pāpako vipāko diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañca, manoduccaritassa pāpako vipāko diṭṭhe ceva dhamme abhisamparāyañcāti. So iti paṭisaṅkhāya kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveti. Vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveti, manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveti. Suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati. Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave paṭisaṅkhānabalaṃ. Katamañca bhikkhave bhāvanābalaṃ tatra bhikkhave yamidaṃ bhāvanābalaṃ. Sekhametaṃ balaṃ. Sekhaṃ hi so bhikkhave balaṃ āgamma rāgaṃ pajahati, dosaṃ pajahati, mohaṃ pajahati, rāgaṃ pahāya dosaṃ pahāya mohaṃ pahāya yaṃ akusalaṃ, taṃ na karoti.9 Yaṃ pāpaṃ. Taṃ na sevati. Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhāvanābalaṃ. Imāni kho bhikkhave dve balānīti.
